prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 51.4 °C (66% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 56.2 °C (56% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 57.7 °C (48% above healthy). Rapid temperature accumulation with minimal inlet-outlet drop indicates loss of cooling circulation.
Valve: small lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.85 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.47 s (2% above healthy). A small switching delay appears during the main pressure transient, reflecting early valve degradation.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.58 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 361 W·min/l (6% below healthy). Flow delivery and motor electrical consumption match expected volumetric efficiency without leakage.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.7 bar (2% below healthy). Marked pressure ripple and reduced peak pressure indicate severe loss of hydraulic accumulator gas pre-charge.
